📖 How to use

  1. Paste your text (a few sentences minimum).
  2. Scores update automatically.
  3. Read the interpretation of each score.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the two scores mean?

Higher Reading Ease (0–100) means easier text; the Grade Level tells you the US school grade needed to understand it.

What is a good score?

90–100 very easy, 80–89 easy, 70–79 fairly easy, 60–69 standard, 50–59 fairly difficult, 30–49 difficult, 0–29 very hard.

How accurate are the scores?

They use the standard Flesch formulas with a heuristic syllable counter — reliable for drafts, but not a substitute for human judgment.
